info.name: Jamii Savings Integration Platform
info.description:
All endpoints for the Jamii Savings assignment: APIM gateway (as a consumer), MI direct (debug), MI management API, and the mock backends (Spring Boot customer REST service and credit-check SOAP service), each with example responses.

Setup: import the environment, disable SSL certificate verification (self-signed certs) in Postman settings, then run '0. Auth'.

This collection is for manual exploration and the demo; the pipeline tests are MI unit tests plus scripts/gateway-check.sh.

item.description: Get an OAuth2 token for Balance and Loan, and an API key for Customer.
